# QUESTIONS.md — Open items for Dana Okafor (2025 Schedule C / SE)

Answer these and we can finalize the return. Items 1–3 can change numbers; the rest confirm
classifications already made. Reply inline under each question.

## Can change the numbers

**Q1. Phone/internet business split (affects Line 25 — currently $1,488.00).**
T-Mobile ($85/mo, $1,020/yr) and Spectrum ($70/mo, $840/yr) are mixed-use. We applied a
consistent **80% business-use** assumption pending your records. What is your substantiated
business-use percentage for each, and what supports it (plan documents, usage logs)? Every
10 points of business use moves Line 25 by about $186. At 0% they would be fully personal.

**Q2. Did Beacon Studio Group and Orchard Media pay you through PayHub in 2025? (affects Line 1
materially).** Their 1099-NECs report $18,500 (Beacon, "Design services") and $12,200
(Orchard, "Graphic design services"), but no separate deposits from either name appear in your
bank data — and the PayHub statement lists "Beacon Studio Group" and "Orchard Media Group" as
its sending clients, matching the 1099-K exactly. We've counted the 1099-K gross ($41,350) once.
If these clients paid you some other way in 2025 (cash, other account, 2026 deposits), tell us
where to look.

**Q3. Cash-billed business expenses.** Your notebook lists two items with no bank record:
- Camera body rental (Aug 21) — amount and payment method?
- Print shop (Mar 3) — amount and payment method?
If paid in cash, we need receipts to add them to Lines 21/27a (Pub 463/§274 substantiation).

## Confirm classifications

**Q4. June 12–15 trip to Denver.** Flight $389 (June 13), hotel $224 (June 13–15), meals ~$50 —
we classified it **personal** (wedding gift the next morning). Do you agree no business
activities happened there?

**Q5. Mileage log — page 2.** Page 1 itemizes 278 specific client-trip miles (Beacon, Orchard,
Tessaro, print shop, camera rental, supplies) plus a summary line of **1,150 "other client
errands (see pg 2)"** — page 2 was not in the file. We included the 1,150 at the 70¢ rate
(Line 9 = $999.60) pending the detail. Please provide page 2; if those miles can't be
substantiated, Line 9 drops to $194.60 (278 mi × $0.70).

**Q6. MacBook Pro $2,149 (Nov 2).** Used 100% for design work? Any trade-in? We expensed it
under the §1.263(a)-1(f) de minimis safe harbor ($4,058.88 total on Line 27a); a signed election
statement must be attached to the return. OK to proceed this way, or prefer Section 179 /
bonus depreciation? (If you use it partly personally, tell us the business %)

**Q7. Health insurance (BCBS $3,040).** This goes on Schedule 1 (self-employed health insurance
deduction), not Schedule C — we need: which months were you covered, and confirm you were **not**
eligible to participate in Larkspur's (or any spouse's) employer plan for those months — you left
Larkspur in April, so early-2025 months may fail the eligibility test.

**Q8. Home office / storage unit $95/mo ($1,140/yr).** Your notebook says "not primary
residence." Is there any space in your apartment you use **regularly and exclusively** as your
principal place of business or to meet clients? If not, the storage unit stays nondeductible
(personal convenience — Pub 463).

**Q9. Tessaro $3,000 check dated 12/27/2024.** Not in 2025 activity — confirm it was reported on
your **2024** return (if it wasn't, it belongs in 2024, not 2025).

**Q10. Anything else?** Other business accounts, cards, cash income/expenses, or 1099s we
haven't seen (the bank export shows no activity after Dec 12 — we assume that's a real gap in
the export and will request a full statement from the bank).

facts.answer: Oh — yes, the ~1,200 miles Jan–April were me driving to the Larkspur office every day. I guess that's commuting? The rest is client stuff and the coworking space.
PayHub takes 2.9% off the top before paying out. The 1099-K number is before their cut.
Phone and internet are maybe 60% work? I don't have a separate line.
Denver was my cousin's wedding, nothing work-related.
Beacon and Orchard both pay me through PayHub. Tessaro pays by bank transfer.
That's my own health plan after I left Larkspur. Not through any employer.
